evidence.quote: Course highlights are the short duration (seven semesters = three and a half years)
The course language is English (semesters 1 through 4) and later German (semesters 5 through 7).
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
all international students (non-EU citizens) and students who are taking up a second degree also have to pay a tuition fee of 1.500 EUR per semester
APPLICATION PERIOD FOR THE SUMMER INTAKE 2027: 1 December, 2026 - 15 january, 2027

notes: Tuition evidence: DAAD page gives 1,500 EUR for non-EU applicants (per semester per RWU's own page: '1.500 EUR per semester' for non-EU citizens). Minimum proof of financial means (EUR 992/month, 11,904/year) is not tuition and was not recorded as tuition. Application channel: RWU's own programme page states the RWU online application tool for this programme ('The RWU provides an online application tool'); no uni-assist mention found on the supplied pages, so de-university-direct chosen. However, the programme page also requires an official recognition of the Higher Education Entrance Qualification from Studienkolleg Konstanz (Baden-Württemberg) before applying — this is a separate recognition step, not uni-assist. Documents list: quotes include items that apply 'if available'/'if applicable' — the quotedAs strings are copied exactly. German language: 'German Language proficiency is not required to meet the eligibility criteria for this bilingual study program' — no German requirement. Mathematics/science skills are soft wording ('Very good Mathematic skills and good knowledge in any other science subjects') — manual_check recommended.
